steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: DNA and Genetics: DNA carries the genetic code that determines an organism's characteristics. Understanding how genes and alleles are inherited allows us to predict the outcomes of genetic crosses using Punnett squares.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Define the terms: gene, allele, genotype, phenotype, dominant, recessive. | In rabbits, black coat (B) is dominant over white coat (b).
